data.title: Social Media Executive
data.details:
Entrepreneurial Development Council India (EDC INDIA) is hiring for a Social Media Executive!

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement social media strategies to increase brand awareness and engagement.
  • Create, curate, and manage all published content (images, video, written).
  • Monitor, listen, and respond to users in a "social" way while cultivating leads and sales.
  • Analyze social media campaigns and translate qualitative data into recommendations and plans for future social media strategies.
  • Stay up-to-date with current technologies and trends in social media, design tools, and applications.

Requirements:

  • Proven working experience in social media marketing or a related field.
  • Excellent consulting, writing, editing (photo/video/text), presentation, and communication skills.
  • Demonstrable social networking experience and social analytics tools knowledge.
  • Knowledge of online marketing and a good understanding of major marketing channels.
  • Positive attitude, detail and customer oriented with good multitasking and organisational ability.

data.title: Senior Web Developer
data.details:
DigiCircal is urgently hiring for a Senior Web Developer!

Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize responsive websites and web applications.
  • Write clean, scalable, and efficient code following industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with designers and teams to convert UI/UX designs into functional web solutions.
  • Manage frontend and backend development tasks.
  • Debug, test, and improve website performance, security, and usability.
  • Integrate APIs, third-party tools, and database systems.
  • Ensure websites are optimized for speed, SEO, and mobile responsiveness.
  • Implement new features and enhancements based on business requirements.
  • Stay updated with the latest web technologies and development trends.

Requirements

  • Minimum 3 years of professional experience in web development.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of technologies like HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), PHP (Core PHP/OOP), MySQL, jQuery, AJAX, Bootstrap 5, JSON and REST API Integration.
  • Experience with version control systems like Git.
  • Knowledge of website optimization, security practices, and responsive design.
  • Experience working with APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and deliver projects within deadlines.
  • Strong communication skills (Mandatory).
  • Must be presentable and able to collaborate effectively with teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with modern web frameworks and CMS platforms.
  • Knowledge of cloud hosting, deployment processes, and server management.
  • Understanding of SEO and website analytics.
  • Familiarity with AI development tools and productivity tools is a plus.

data.title: Business Development Manager
data.details:
About the Company

Girikand Travels Pvt Ltd is a leading travel management company dedicated to providing exceptional travel experiences. With a strong focus on customer satisfaction and innovation, we offer a wide range of services including corporate travel, leisure holidays, and MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions). We pride ourselves on our extensive network, cutting-edge technology, and a team of passionate professionals committed to making every journey memorable.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve business development goals in the B2B sector.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities, fostering strong relationships with potential clients.
  • Manage and nurture existing client accounts to ensure long-term partnerships and repeat business.
  • Conduct market research to identify trends, competitor activities, and potential areas for growth.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling presentations and proposals to prospective clients.
  • Negotiate contracts and close deals, ensuring profitability and client satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless service delivery and client support.
  • Provide regular reports on sales performance, market feedback, and pipeline status.

Requirements

  • 4-10 years of proven experience in B2B sales, preferably within the travel or related industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed sales targets.
  • Strong understanding of the B2B sales cycle and client relationship management.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • A results-oriented mindset with a passion for business development.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
